title: Matrixport begins operating
description: Matrixport was founded in 2019 as a digital-asset financial-services platform combining investment, lending, trading, custody, and related services.
notes: The exact launch day was not identified; 1 January is a sortable approximate date based on current first-party company materials.

title: Matrixport launches Lite interface with yield products
description: Matrixport introduced a simplified app interface that included fixed-income products and yield access for USDC, USDT, BTC, and ETH.
notes: Historical advertised rates are launch context only and are not treated as current or guaranteed.

title: Matrixport publishes fixed-income API
description: Matrixport's fixed-income API documentation records an initial version for multi-currency fixed-income products and order management.
notes: The API version date documents an operational fixed-income product surface, not necessarily the first retail fixed-income launch.

title: Matrixport launches non-liquidation loan product
description: Matrixport announced an altcoin-collateralized stablecoin loan with fixed interest and no margin calls tied to the initial loan-to-value ratio.
notes: Product terms, supported assets, custody, repayment, and availability can change.

title: Matrixport remains active across yield and lending
description: Current first-party materials describe active fixed-income, flexible-saving, staking, structured-yield, and collateralized-loan products across supported jurisdictions.
notes: Current-state snapshot; rates, principal language, strategies, lockups, licenses, legal entities, custody, and availability can change.

title: Coinchange brings its proprietary yield platform to market
description: Coinchange states that it brought its proprietary automated digital-asset yield platform to market in Q3 2021 after two years of development.
notes: 1 July represents the start of Q3 because an exact launch day was not identified.

title: Coinchange documents the High Yield Account arrangement
description: Coinchange's historical High Yield Account agreement defined an asset-management arrangement for customer yield accounts and the applicable platform terms.
notes: Historical account terms are not automatically applied to every current API, vault, business, or non-custodial product.

title: Coinchange operates multi-strategy Earn infrastructure
description: Current first-party materials describe individual and business Earn accounts, API and vault infrastructure, and automated multi-strategy digital-asset yield products.
notes: Current-state snapshot; APY, strategies, liquidity, fees, product access, and legal structure can change.

title: Coinchange publishes current transparency and custody claims
description: Coinchange describes on-chain strategy transparency and product-dependent custody or key-control arrangements while developing additional trust-minimized infrastructure.
notes: First-party transparency and custody claims are recorded as claims and do not prove universal customer protection or eliminate strategy and counterparty risk.
